progression.narrative: The performance opens on B2 and dwells most on B in Reng-e Nastari. The line peaks at Gb4 (373.9 Hz) at 2:38.7. It closes on B2, not the tonic (B2 → D3 → B2 → B2 → Cs3 → B2).

flags: tonic E set in the catalog (Nava's finalis E (11 of the suite's 22 gushe-ha end there, including both daramads). From Oshagh on, the 4th below Nava's finalis becomes the finalis, and Hoseyni, Busalik and Neyriz are in the mode of Shur (Farhat 1990, pp. 85-86). The vote picked that 4th below (B). Inference, not yet by ear); the runs' vote favoured 123.0 Hz (B)
